subject: Procurement next steps & vendor packet - Acme Analytics
message_1_body:
Hi Jamie / Asha (procurement),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Acme's search and insights roadmap. Per our call, you flagged procurement as the main gating item (vendor setup, W-9, and PO process). I wanted to summarize next steps and share the vendor packet so your procurement team has what they need.

Recap / asks:
- You prefer to pay via PO (net 30) rather than card — please confirm who in procurement will issue the PO and the typical lead time.
- Acme needs a completed vendor intake packet (W-9 for US entity or W-8 for foreign).
- Banking details and remittance instructions are requested for AP.
- There's interest in whether Redwood is available via AWS Marketplace — helpful if you can indicate if marketplace procurement would simplify your process.

Attachments I'm including: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (vendor setup, contact, insurance), W9_Redwood.pdf, Banking_Instructions.pdf. I'll also add a DocuSign link for the Master Services Agreement if procurement asks for signed paperwork up front.

Proposed timeline: if procurement can return the vendor packet + PO within 10 business days, we can aim to schedule onboarding the week after PO receipt.

Please let me know if I should route anything to a specific AP contact — happy to loop Rafael (CC'd) who will own commercial coordination and quote updates.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
message_2_subject: Re: Post-call: procurement intake & next steps
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. Looping Asha from procurement. Asha: we typically require a vendor packet + W-9 before setting up a vendor record. PO vs marketplace: our default is PO, but if Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace with Spot/Commit options it can speed approvals.

Asha, procurement questions:
- Do you accept DocuSign for our internal routing (yes/no)?
- Banking detail format: we need bank name, account type, routing/IBAN and a copy of a voided check if domestic.
- Insurance info: our SOWs require general liability and cyber liability limits — see attached note below.

Rough timeline: if we get the completed packet by next Friday (2026-04-10), I can get the vendor set up and issue a PO the following week.

Thanks,
Jamie
Head of Data Products
Acme Analytics
jamie.oneill@acmeanalytics.com
On Fri, Apr 4, 2026 at 2:23 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Acme's search and insights roadmap...
message_3_body:
Hi Asha / Procurement team,

Attaching the vendor packet and the W-9 here per Jamie's note. I included a short banking instructions PDF that shows our remittance and ACH details. We can also provide a voided check if required — please confirm where to upload that in your vendor portal.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/REDWOOD-VENDOR-PACKET (you can sign the MSA or accept the vendor terms there). For marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace but sometimes procurement teams still require a vendor record; we can support either path. If you prefer marketplace-only procurement, note that marketplace payments can add 1-2 weeks depending on procurement approvals.

What I need from you to move forward:
1) Confirm preferred payment method (PO vs card vs marketplace).
2) Confirm whether DocuSign is acceptable for your internal routing.
3) If PO, please share the AP contact and PO issuance lead time (we heard ~5-7 business days from Jamie).

We want to make this as painless as possible — Rafael will handle commercial/redlines if anything in the packet needs ops/legal review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, W9_Redwood.pdf, Banking_Instructions.pdf)
message_4_body:
Hi Marissa / Rafael,

Thanks for the packet — received and currently routing. Answers below:
- DocuSign: yes, accepted for signature routing.
- Banking: ACH details are sufficient; we would only need a voided check for external vendor setup if your bank requests it, but ACH + routing/account + remittance instructions is fine.
- Insurance: your vendor packet lists cyber liability; please confirm the carrier and policy limits when you send final countersigned docs.

We will aim to have the vendor set up and a PO issued by 2026-04-14 if no additional legal review is required. If legal requests changes to the MSA, that could add time — please flag any uncommon clauses.

Marketplace: if you can provide the AWS Marketplace seller ID and the listing URL, procurement will evaluate whether marketplace procurement provides a faster path.

AP contact for PO issuance: AP Team <ap@acmeanalytics.com>. Typical lead time: 5-8 business days after vendor record creation.

Regards,
Asha Mehta
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
